async function wakeAndCheck(cfg) {
  var ch = await checkChrome(cfg.cdp_port);
  if (ch.ok) return ch;
  if (cfg.chrome_service) {
    try {
      require("node:child_process").execFileSync(
        "/usr/bin/sudo",
        ["-n", "/usr/local/bin/chrome-alma-ensure", cfg.chrome_service],
        { timeout: 45000, stdio: "ignore" });
    } catch (e) { /* sin permiso o fallo: seguimos y reportamos CHROME_DOWN */ }
    ch = await checkChrome(cfg.cdp_port);
  }
  return ch;
}
